LAGOS STATE GOVERNMENT
MINISTRY OF TRANSPORTATION
PRESS RELEASE
LASG ISSUES TRAFFIC ADVISORY AHEAD OF MARYLAND INDEPENDENCE BRIDGE NIGHT REPAIRS

The Lagos State Government has issued a traffic advisory ahead of the emergency repairs on the damaged section of the wall of the Maryland Independence Bridge. 
The repairs will run from Saturday, 16th August, 2025 to Tuesday, 19th August, 2025, between the hours of 11:00 p.m. and 4:00 a.m. daily, (Night time).
Consequently, motorists are hereby enjoined to use this alternative route during the 3-day night repair works:

Motorists inbound Oshodi/Ojuelegba/Stadium/Lagos will be diverted at Maria Lodge in Maryland into the Maryland Bridge to connect Idiroko inwards Anthony to continue their journeys. This is because the main carriageway will not be opened to vehicular movement.
During the course of the repairs, motorists inbound Ketu/Ikorodu from Lagos/Stadium/Anthony will have unhindered vehicular movement.

The Commissioner for Transportation, Mr. Oluwaseun Osiyemi, assures that traffic management personnel will be deployed to the affected area to minimise inconvenience and manage vehicular movement during the repairs. He urged motorists to comply with the directives of the officers on ground to ensure smooth traffic flow.

ADVISORY: Motorists are implored to be patient, as the partial road closure is part of the traffic management plan for the rehabilitation and replacement works on the expansion joints of Maryland Independence Bridge.

Mr. Oluwaseun Osiyemi,
Lagos State Commissioner for Transportation,

14th August, 2025

[4:22PM] #OkotaIsolo #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic on Daleko–Mushin Bridge is moving freely, as is the route from 5 Star to connect under the Iyana Isolo Bridge.
Ilasa through Ballet to Ijesha, inward Mile 2, is experiencing smooth flow. Movement from Oke-Afa Bridge to Pako is also fast in both directions.

The Pako–Akiti–Chemist–Ago Roundabout route remains free-flowing in both directions.
Cele Link Bridge traffic is light, and the stretch from Cele through Rain Oil–Ago Intersection to Ago Palace Way is also moving well, with a smooth return trip.

Ilasa–Transformer to Apata Junction is clear in both directions. Ibeh Road to Ago Roundabout is equally free-flowing.
From Kogberegbe through Ire Akari, Ile Ibadan, Mustapha, Ishaga, College, Omonije, Aiye, Limca, and LASUTECH Roundabout, traffic is smooth in both directions.

Currently, there are no reports of impediments or obstructions, and our men are ensuring ease of traffic movement.
